site.title: CMPM 121 — Project Archive
site.lede: Eleven projects from one quarter of game development, collected into a single repository with their complete history. Every build below runs from this site.

projects.label: D1
projects.title: Studio Clicker
projects.description: A music-studio clicker: lay down takes, earn royalties, and reinvest into bigger equipment.
projects.head: main

projects.label: D2
projects.title: Mapcrafter
projects.description: A dungeon-map editor with snap-to-grid drawing, custom stamps, JSON save/load, and PNG export.
projects.head: main

projects.label: D3
projects.title: SpaceCrafter
projects.description: Stranded on a hostile planet: gather materials, craft components, and repair your ship before time runs out.
projects.head: main

projects.label: D4
projects.title: Voxel Dragon
projects.description: A voxel dragon on a grid with snake rules, built in Godot with art generated in Blender.
projects.head: main

projects.label: E1
projects.title: Three browser sketches
projects.description: Lighting controls, an auto-targeting display, and a puzzle renderer — three independent pages.
projects.head: main

projects.label: E2
projects.title: Workshop stations
projects.description: Allocation, rover, and counter stations sharing one stylesheet and a single entry page.
projects.head: main

projects.label: E3
projects.title: A face with options
projects.description: A script-built SVG face with options and a Spin button, saved as named variants.
projects.head: C

projects.label: E4
projects.title: Neon Warden
projects.description: A vertical shooter with a Phaser playfield, HTML score panels, a route map, and an attract mode.
projects.head: main

projects.label: E5
projects.title: Crate Expectations
projects.description: A Sokoban-style puzzle game: rules in plain TypeScript, the screen drawn with React.
projects.head: main

projects.label: S1
projects.title: Counter starter
projects.description: Section activity: a counter that increments on screen, with the starter's exception removed.
projects.head: main

projects.label: D1-AI
projects.title: Studio Clicker (AI build)
projects.description: An incremental music-career game built with an AI pair, from a bedroom setup to a full record label.
projects.head: main
